messages.subject: revised User's Guide and Reference Manual
parts:
Here's a link to version Beta.2 of the Stan User's Guide
and Reference Manual:

http://stan.googlecode.com/files/stan-reference-beta.2.pdf

We've been playing with the syntax for Stan variable
declarations. And I've gone through and copy-edited
the manual and revised it with more descriptions. There's
a new section on vectorization in the optimization chapter
in the user's guide.

Please let us know if you find any errors at this point.
It's easiest to do that via e-mail to this list or
directly to:

mc.sta...@gmail.com

We'd also be happy to listen to any feedback you have on
what's confusing.

- Bob
